creator: Alexander Terp
description: Raised 2026-10-24 with a_2izzZ0Sag, which made pane verbs answer a name from before a rename with the pane's present name, callsign@machine and id (Address::Renamed in muster_core::pane_address, fed by the daemon's Pane.former_labels). muster msg resolves recipients by muster-msg's own participant rules, which know nothing of former names, so --to kelp after kelp was renamed is still refused as nobody, or reaches whoever holds kelp now. docs/cli/limits.md says so. An agent addressing itself or a peer from $MUSTER_PANE_NAME is the common way to hit it.
title: muster msg post --to a name from before a rename gets no pointer to the pane's name now
